I'm landing on approve, with willingness to fund around 70-75 and confidence around 70, treating the interpreted success probability as 95 and unavailability as 5, while noting the relevant evidence IDs I'd cite to support this.

I'll avoid inventing IDs and stick strictly to CASE-01 through CASE-04. Weighing willingness to fund at roughly 70 given the low risk profile — reasonable but not maximal — with confidence around 72.
